newsitem.title: USA: Lincoln Q4 property operating income down.
newsitem.headline: Lincoln Q4 property operating income down.

text.p: Lincoln National Corp said operating income from its property-casualty segment declined in the fourth quarter due to unusually heavy natural peril losses.
Lincoln National said the property-casualty segment reported fourth quarter operating income of $41.3 million compared with $55.7 million a year ago.
Losses from natural perils in the fourth quarter totaled $21.4 million, after minority interest and taxes, Lincoln National said.
More than half of the losses were from December storms in the Northwest, Lincoln National said.
For the year, the property-casualty segment's operating income fell to $123.1 million, down from $152.6 million in 1995, Lincoln National said.

Lincoln National said the decline was attributable to its reduced ownership of American States Financial Corporation -- 83 percent since the initial public offering in May -- and higher natural peril losses. Natural peril losses for the year, after minority interest and taxes, were $98.4 million, compared with $79.4 million, after-tax, in 1995.
